shared_elements: frontal anthropomorphic figure with arms extended/raised
justification: The only real overlap is the presence of frontal humanoid figures with prominently displayed arms, a near-universal motif; A additionally features large hooked-beak birds perched above and a symmetrical pair of confronted birds below, which have no counterpart in B. A is a vertically stacked, tightly interlocking column of hatched, volumetric carved forms, whereas B is a flat, sketchy pair of stick-limbed figures brandishing raised weapons scattered across an open field, so relationships, arrangement and drawing conventions differ almost entirely.
